environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8.0 application deployed on ECS Fargate in a private subnet with NAT gateway for S3 access. The ECS task role has s3:PutObject, s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket on arn:aws:s3:::prod-documents-* with no additional constraints. S3 buckets have no bucket policy restrictions. Traffic to S3 goes through the NAT gateway to the public S3 endpoint. No VPC endpoint is configured.

config.network: Private subnet with NAT gateway, no VPC endpoint
